_comment: Bistro walk on Quest driven by the scene's own camera animation: the camera path samples animation 'Animation' on node 'Camera' of the loaded Bistro scene (the 8 s cubic path authored in the Animation window and saved in bistro_src.glb and its quest prepared asset) at frame_dt per measured frame (90 Hz, 720 frames), so one measured window is one pass of the path (the path is indexed by measured frame, a timedemo: the same frames every run). Run like benchmark_bistro.json: --editor-args --no-scene --bench-to-device --load-scene <device path of the Bistro prepared asset>.
name: bistro_street_90
